instruction:
I want to prevent VLC from exceeding a certain volume level to protect my hearing. Please configure VLC to set the maximum volume to 75% instead of the default.
How can I change the maximum volume setting?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting VLC's maximum volume to 75 (qt-max-volume=75). Uses existing check_qt_max_volume metric function. Expected value is 75.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts VLC config file (vlcrc) from platform-specific paths
Metric function correctly parses config file and searches for 'qt-max-volume=' setting
Metric correctly defaults to '125' (VLC's actual default) if setting not found
Metric correctly compares extracted value with expected value (75)
Expected value (75) is semantically correct for setting VLC max volume to 75%
Postconfig appropriately kills and relaunches VLC to ensure config is written to disk
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the exact requirement in the instruction
Data flow is correct: config extraction -> parsing -> comparison with expected
Metric parameter handling is correct: directly accesses rule['expected_qt_max_volume'] when expected.type='rule'
